olivia_acme: Hey, escalating a customer issue — tool call works in Python but fails from TS/Go. Error from API: "tool_input.schema_validation_failed: attachments.0.content expected string, got object". Request id 01F8ABCD. SDKs: py 0.8.2, ts 0.10.1, go 0.4.5.
emma_support: thanks — can you paste minimal repro for each client and the failing payload we see in server logs? also which model/tool? :thinking:
olivia_acme: Tool is `pdf_processor.extract_text`. Python call (works):
```
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key=KEY)
c.call_tool("pdf_processor.extract_text", {"attachments": [{"content": b"%PDF-..."}]})
```
Server received attachments[0].content as base64 string. TS example (fails):
```ts
const payload = { attachments: [{ content: new Uint8Array(buffer) }] }
client.callTool('pdf_processor.extract_text', payload)
```
Error is schema validation failed (type mismatch). Logs show server received a JSON object: {"content": {"type":"Buffer","data":[...]}}
emma_support: aha. That Buffer shape looks like Node's Buffer serialized by JSON.stringify on the SDK path. TS SDK should convert to base64 string, not the Node Buffer object. @taylor_sdk can you chase?
taylor_sdk: seeing this now. Repro locally with ts 0.10.1. We call JSON.stringify on body and rely on built-in JSON conversion — Node Buffer becomes {type:"Buffer",data:[...]} unless we encode. We did a fix earlier for streams but apparently missed arraybuffers/uint8.
raj_engineering: also check Go SDK — its encoding of []byte should be base64 in JSON encoder by default, but if we wrap in a custom struct with json.RawMessage it can leak. Can you paste the exact Go snippet olivia?
olivia_acme: Go snippet (fails):
```go
payload := map[string]interface{}{"attachments": []interface{}{map[string]interface{}{"content": fileBytes}}}
client.CallTool("pdf_processor.extract_text", payload)
```
Where fileBytes is []byte. Server log shows attachments[0].content = [34,37,80,68,...] (array of numbers) — not base64 string.
emma_support: so three clients serializing bytes differently: py -> base64 string, ts -> Node Buffer object, go -> raw numeric array. That explains schema reject. We need SDKs to unify to base64 strings for bytes-type tool args.
taylor_sdk: quick patch idea: in TS SDK serializer, detect Buffer/ArrayBuffer/TypedArray and convert to base64 via Buffer.from(...).toString('base64') before JSON. Also ensure we set content_encoding: "base64"? Our tool schema expects string not object; better to keep just base64 string. Will open PR.
raj_engineering: for Go, ensure encoding/json encodes []byte as base64-encoded string (it should). The problem is using map[string]interface{} with a []byte might be getting transformed to []uint8? Wait default json.Marshal([]byte) => base64 string, but if someone uses fmt.Sprintf or custom marshalling it might become numeric array. Are we sure client.CallTool uses json.Marshal? If using encoding/gob or proto it could differ.
taylor_sdk: I've got a unit test failing where Buffer gets converted to {type:...,data:[...]} because our serializer is doing a deep-clone that uses Object.assign on Node Buffer. I'll push a fix to convert Buffers early.
emma_support: olivia, for customer immediate workaround — pass base64 yourself from TS/Go, e.g. `attachments[0].content = Buffer.from(buffer).toString('base64')` (TS) or `attachments[0].content = base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(fileBytes)` (Go). That should unblock.
olivia_acme: ok I'll try that and report back. We need this fixed ASAP — multiple teams hit it when sending images/docs.
bugbot: Incident created: INC-2026-874, priority P2, assigned to sdk-team.
taylor_sdk: opening PR: https://git.redwood/sdks/ts/pull/482 — serializer: normalizeBinary -> base64 for Buffer/ArrayBuffer/TypedArray. Added tests and changelog.
raj_engineering: I'll add a defensive check server-side to accept numeric arrays and convert to base64 for backward compat for one release cycle. Patch queued.
emma_support: great. olivia, can you confirm after sending base64 manually? also paste request id if you hit it again so we can attach logs.
olivia_acme: quick test done — manual base64 from TS fixed the call. Sending full run now, will post results.
emma_support: thanks. Follow-ups: TS SDK release candidate, Go team to verify their callers use json.Marshal not custom encoder, server tolerant decode patch, and support note to customers. Adding to support KB.
olivia_acme: all good, customer confirmed. Will close once TS patch shipped. :thumbsup:
